channel.title: Vaxopedia – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Vaxopedia – Bias and Credibility (vaxopedia.org)

item.title: Pro-Infection Influencers Don't Understand Measles Encephalitis
item.description: Understand the Pro-Infection Influencers who oppose vaccinations and actually want their kids to get measles, pertussis, and other life-threatening diseases.

item.title: Where Were the Autistic Kids and Adults in the 1970s?
item.description: Explore the reality of autistic kids in the 1970s and the misconceptions surrounding their presence in schools during that era.

item.title: RFK Jr's ACIP Committee Has Scheduled a Meeting Next Month
item.description: The upcoming ACIP meeting, led by RFK Jr., will focus on discussions surrounding COVID-19 vaccine injuries and Long-COVID, diverting attention from measles resurgence and vaccine hesitancy. Critics argue that the committee's agenda aims to blame vaccines for Long-COVID symptoms, despite studies indicating higher risks among unvaccinated individuals.

item.title: Did Tom Shimabukuro Say COVID Vaccines Were Causing Debilitating Illnesses?
item.description: What did Tom Shimabukuro say about COVID vaccine safety? Discover the facts behind the claims and the misinformation spread by influencers.

item.title: How the Modern Anti-Vaccine Movement Resembles a Religious Cult
item.description: Discover why some view the anti-vaccine movement as a religious cult and the impact of influential figures on vaccine hesitancy.

item.title: Introducing Angie Farella - RFK Jr.'s Latest Addition to ACIP
item.description: Explore the controversial views of Angie Farella, a member of the ACIP Committee, and her strange views on COVID, measles, and vaccines.

item.title: Measles Is Spreading: What You Need to Know
item.description: Measles is spreading across the United States, affecting those without travel history. Learn why this is concerning.

item.title: Pandemic Revisionism Can't Erase How Many Kids Died With COVID
item.description: Anti-vaccine influencers are downplaying the severity of COVID-19’s impact on children, falsely suggesting it was not serious. Research indicates that approximately 2,390 children may have died from COVID, with many being unvaccinated. Misinformation surrounding the pandemic obscures these fatalities, emphasizing the need to remember the real consequences of COVID-19.

item.title: Misinformation Shills Vaccines and Their Profits
item.description: Uncover the truth about misinformation shills against vaccines and the financial motives behind anti-vaccine propaganda that misleads the public.

item.title: RFK Jr.'s Promise to Find the Cause of Autism
item.description: Did RFK Jr ever find cause of autism? Explore his shifting timeline and how his statements hurt autistic people.
